senses.gloss: m. ch. (v. סְאֵב II, סִיב) = h. שָׂב, grey, old; elder; ancestor; scholar (= h. זָקֵן).
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 3:2">Targ. Is. III, 2</cite>.
<cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 24:2">Targ. Gen. XXIV, 2</cite>; a. fr.—
Targ. Y. II, Lev. XXII, 27 סַבְיָא.—Targ. II Esth. VII, 9 כאגג אבא סב (ed. Lag. אבא . טב, corr. acc.) like Agag my grandfather.—Y. Yeb. XII, 12ᵈ bot., opp. טַלְיְתָא.
<cite ref="Chullin 6a:2">Ḥull. 6ᵃ</cite> <he>אשכחיה ההוא ס׳</he> an old man (or scholar) met him; <cite ref="Shabbat 34a:1">Sabb. 34ᵃ</cite>.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 74:17">Gen. R. s. 74</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Psalms 124:1">Ps. CXXIV, 1</cite>) <he>ישראל ס׳</he> it means Israel the patriarch (not Israel the people); Midr. Till. to Ps. l. c.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nedarim 10:8:8">Y. Ned. X, end, 42ᵇ</cite> <he>לסָבִי</he> to my ancestor.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nedarim 10:8:8">Ib.</cite> <he>ר׳ דוסתי ס׳</he> R. Dostay senior; a. fr.—[<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Maaser Sheni 5:3:9">Y. Maas. Sh. V, 56ᶜ</cite> top, v. <cite ref="K00891"><he>כַּסָּא</he> I</cite>.]—Pl. <cite ref="O00057"><he>סָבִין</he></cite>, <cite ref="O00052"><he>סָבַיָּא</he></cite>, <cite ref="O00029"><he>סָבֵי</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Zechariah 8:4">Targ. Zech. VIII, 4</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Joel 1:14">Targ. Joel I, 14</cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 20:29">Targ. Prov. XX, 29</cite> (Ms. <he>סֵיבֵי</he>); a. fr.—Y. Peah VII, end, 21ᵇ <he>אית הוו ס׳ וכ׳</he> there were (poor) old men in our days &c.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 33a:17">Kidd. 33ᵃ</cite> <he>ר׳</he> … <he>ס׳ דארמאי</he> R. J. used to rise before gentile old men.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 17b:5">Snh. 17ᵇ</cite> <he>ס׳ דסורא</he> the scholars of Sura.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 58b:1">B. Bath. 58ᵇ</cite> <he>סאבי דיהודאי</he> the Jewish scholars.
Bekh. 8ᵇ, v. אַתִּינָס; a. fr.—Fem. (סָבָא), סַבְתָא.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Maaser Sheni 3:3:8">Y. Maas. Sh. III, 54ᵇ</cite> top <he>אמר לון חד סבא</he> (read: <he>אמרה לון הדא ס׳</he>) said to them a certain matron (prob. wife of a scholar).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Maaser Sheni 3:3:8">Ib.</cite> <he>הדא סבתא … מימר</he> that matron was of the opinion.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 125b:1">B. Bath. 125ᵇ</cite> <he>נכסי לס׳</he> I bequeathe my property to my grandmother.

Ib. אי קדים ס׳ וכ׳ if that grandmother had sold the property bequeathed to her before the claim could be preferred, the sale would have been valid; a. fr.—Pl. סָבָן. Targ. Zech. l. c.; a. e.—[סָב to be old, v. סֵיב.]
